ev-1a52d0ae31.rationale: Legacy tier T0: the evidence is unresolved and the fixtures were unscored, so no outcome is asserted. Not asserted: disputed property — the length and alphabet of the sk_ body (48 lowercase hexadecimal characters), which no provider-owned source states. No provider-owned source decides it and the research pass recorded it as searched-and-not-found, so the benchmark stops asserting it (docs/decisions/2026-09-24-stop-asserting-provider-undecided-format-properties.md). Kept as history; the product's behaviour on this property is unmeasured for elevenlabs-api-key.
